staudt:1847.author: Karl Georg Christian von Staudt
staudt:1847.publisher: Verlag der Friedr. Korn'schen Buchhandlung, Nürnberg
staudt:1847.note: Foundational treatise of pure synthetic projective geometry without any metric length, angle, or arithmetic ratio; introduces ideal points/lines via parallel sheaves (§ 2), quadrangle harmonic separation (§§ 6–8), and conic polarities (§§ 18–19).

staudt:1856.author: Karl Georg Christian von Staudt
staudt:1856.work: Beiträge zur Geometrie der Lage, Erstes Heft
staudt:1856.publisher: Verlag der Friedr. Korn'schen Buchhandlung, Nürnberg
staudt:1856.note: Extends pure synthetic geometry to imaginary points, lines, and planes represented by elliptic involutions equipped with sense.

staudt:1857.author: Karl Georg Christian von Staudt
staudt:1857.work: Beiträge zur Geometrie der Lage, Zweites Heft
staudt:1857.publisher: Verlag der Friedr. Korn'schen Buchhandlung, Nürnberg
staudt:1857.note: Introduces the Rechnung mit Würfen (Algebra of Throws): straightedge-only addition and multiplication of ordered projective tetrads relative to gauge points (P_0, P_1, P_inf), generating projective abscissae synthetically.

staudt:1860.author: Karl Georg Christian von Staudt
staudt:1860.work: Beiträge zur Geometrie der Lage, Drittes Heft
staudt:1860.publisher: Verlag der Friedr. Korn'schen Buchhandlung, Nürnberg
staudt:1860.note: Completes von Staudt's three-part sequel on imaginary elements, projective coordinates in space, and higher-order geometric forms.

pasch:1882.author: Moritz Pasch
pasch:1882.publisher: Verlag von B. G. Teubner, Leipzig
pasch:1882.note: First rigorous axiomatization of linear betweenness (§ 1), planar separation (Pasch's Axiom, § 2 IV. Grundsatz, p. 21), ideal sheaves without infinity (§§ 8–11), and the hypothetico-deductive method (§ 12, p. 98).

euclid:elements.author: Euclid (trans. T. L. Heath)
euclid:elements.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
euclid:elements.locus: Book I, Postulates 1–3; Propositions I.16, I.21, I.31; Book V
euclid:elements.note: Classical Greek deductive synthesis whose unstated planar order assumptions in I.16 and I.21 are resolved by Pasch's Axiom.

pappus:synagoge.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus:synagoge.note: Preserves the Hexagon Theorem (VII.139) and invariance of harmonic and cross-ratio tetrads under central projection.

mobius:1827.author: August Ferdinand Möbius
mobius:1827.note: Introduces barycentric coordinates and rational projective nets constructed by repeated straightedge intersections.

steiner:1832.author: Jakob Steiner
steiner:1832.work: Systematische Entwickelung der Abhängigkeit geometrischer Gestalten von einander
steiner:1832.note: Generates conics from projectively related pencils of rays while still defining projectivity via metrical cross-ratios.

steiner:1833.author: Jakob Steiner
steiner:1833.work: Die geometrischen Constructionen, ausgeführt mittelst der geraden Linie und Eines festen Kreises
steiner:1833.note: Establishes the Poncelet-Steiner theorem and straightedge-only harmonic parallel constructions prior to von Staudt's pure incidence synthesis.

klein:1871.author: Felix Klein
klein:1871.note: Grounds Cayley's projective metrics on von Staudt's metric-free projective coordinates and identifies the continuity hypothesis needed in von Staudt's Fundamental Theorem.

klein:1873.author: Felix Klein
klein:1873.work: Über die sogenannte Nicht-Euklidische Geometrie (Zweiter Aufsatz)
klein:1873.note: Refines the topological order analysis of projective ranges and harmonic nets, directly motivating Pasch's 1882 axiomatization.

darboux:1880.author: Jean-Gaston Darboux
darboux:1880.work: Sur le théorème fondamental de la géométrie projective
darboux:1880.note: Proves that every bijection of the real projective line preserving harmonic tetrads is continuous and projective.

vailati:1895.author: Giovanni Vailati
vailati:1895.work: Sulle relazioni di posizione tra punti d'una linea chiusa
vailati:1895.note: Formalizes cyclical separation of point pairs on closed projective lines in continuation of Pasch's order axioms.

russell:1897.author: Bertrand Russell
russell:1897.work: An Essay on the Foundations of Geometry
russell:1897.note: Philosophical critique of von Staudt's quadrangle construction and the qualitative nature of projective geometry.

hilbert:1899.author: David Hilbert
hilbert:1899.note: Codifies Pasch's planar order axiom as Axiom II 4 and adapts von Staudt's algebra of throws into segment arithmetic via Desargues and Pascal.

russell:1903.author: Bertrand Russell
russell:1903.note: Reconstructs descriptive (Pasch) and projective (von Staudt, Pieri) geometries in relational logic.

hessenberg:1905.author: Gerhard Hessenberg
hessenberg:1905.work: Beweis des Desarguesschen Satzes aus dem Pascalschen
hessenberg:1905.note: Proves that Pappus's Hexagon Theorem implies Desargues's Theorem in any projective plane, linking commutativity of throws to quadrangle uniqueness.

veblen:1910.author: Oswald Veblen and John Wesley Young
veblen:1910.locus: Chapter VI (Algebra of Points and One-Dimensional Coordinate Systems)
veblen:1910.note: Modern axiomatic presentation of von Staudt's algebra of throws (algebra of points) over arbitrary division rings and commutative fields.

hoenen:1954.author: Peter Hubert Jacob Hoenen, S.J.
hoenen:1954.work: De Noetica Geometriae: Origine Theoriae Cognitionis
hoenen:1954.note: Examines Pasch's nuclear propositions (Stammsätze) and hypothetico-deductive formalism through Thomistic epistemology.

tarski:1959.author: Alfred Tarski
tarski:1959.locus: The Axiomatic Method, ed. L. Henkin, P. Suppes, A. Tarski, pp. 16–29
tarski:1959.note: Reduces planar order to the five-point inner/outer Pasch axiom in a decidable first-order theory of betweenness and congruence.
